predictedBugs: Alert IDs could collide across explicit --today dates if they used only the request execution timestamp date; IDs now include the evaluated CRM date.
A mailer send count above the 500 citation bound could report an uncited aggregate; send counts are now bounded and emit result-limit.
Help, connections, task, mailer and activity intents could over-read unrelated repositories; dispatch now loads only the read seams each intent needs.
edgeCases: An instant near midnight is classified by the configured IANA CRM time zone, including DST, while an invalid zone fails explicitly.
A 501-contact repository is capped at 500 with a warning and a zero-match query says no authorized record matched.
Missing activity or mailer capability, revoked membership, mode mismatch and telemetry-sink failure degrade or fail without mutation or sample fallback.
